intro: Translate PDF uses AI to put a document's text into another language and gives it back to you as Word, PDF or both. You can translate into Spanish, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Catalan, Dutch, Polish, Romanian, Galician or Basque; the original language is detected automatically or you choose it under more options.

The layout is simple: the headings and paragraphs of each page are rebuilt, broken lines and hyphenated words are joined, and each page of the original starts a new page with its number so you can compare. Images, tables and the exact position of elements are not kept; if you need to get closer to the original design, adjust the Word file.

Under “Terms not to translate” write, one per line, the names of brands, products or technical terms that must stay as they are, up to 1,000 characters. Paragraphs are sent to the model in batches and requested aligned one to one, so the order of the text is preserved. The PDF is produced on our server from the translated text.

This is a beta tool, subject to the daily AI allowance. Before the first task you accept a notice: the document's text is sent to an external provider through OpenRouter, possibly outside the European Union. Do not use it with confidential documents, and review the translation before using it for anything important.
steps: Upload the PDF and, if it is long, choose the page range you want to translate.
Choose the target language, the format and, if needed, the terms not to translate.
Accept the AI notice and download the Word file, the PDF or both.

faq.q: How many AI requests does it use?
faq.a: One for each batch of paragraphs that fits in the model's response: a short document usually needs just one, and a long one needs several. They are reserved before starting; if they exceed what your plan allows per task, the task stops without using any and you can translate the document in page ranges.

You need an account. With the free one, 3 AI requests a day, 5 per task and 30 pages per task; with Pro, 30 a day, 20 per task and 150 pages. Repeating the same translation in another format uses nothing, because the result is kept for 24 hours with your files.
